Trigger_Explanation: The test cases are calling the showBug() method of the Foo class which triggers the bug because its related object mocks are not correctly initialized.
Model_Explanation: The described bug is present in the provided Java code. The Foo class is initializing Mockito objects in its constructor, which is not compliant with the bug rule. The bug rule states that objects annotated with Mockito annotations @Mock, @Spy, @Captor, or @InjectMocks need to be initialized explicitly. The code should be refactored to initialize the Mockito objects in a setup method or annotate the test class with @RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class) or @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class).
